title: Lateral Driver
text: Lateral path-tracking controller, 14 inputs, 2 outputs; {Steering override} sets the override steering command, {Steering hold} sets the hold steering command, {Steering disable} sets the disable steering command, {Output handwheel angle} sets the steering port units in rad, {Lateral control type, controlTypeLat} sets the controller, {Angular units, angUnits} sets the input and output port angular, {Driver response time, tau} sets the response time, {Preview distance, L} sets the distance, {Vector input for poses} selects to create RefPose and CurrPose input, {Include dynamics} selects to include dynamics, {Position gain of forward motion, PositionGainF} sets the position gain of vehicle in forward motion, {Position gain of reverse motion, PositionGainR} sets the position gain of vehicle in reverse motion, {Yaw rate feedback gain, YawRateGain} sets the yaw rate feedback, {Steering angle feedback gain, DelayGain} sets the steering angle feedback, {Forward location of tire, a} sets the along vehicle longitudinal axis, {Rearward location of tire, b} sets the along vehicle longitudinal axis, {Vehicle mass, m} sets the mass, {Front tire cornering coefficient, Cy_f} sets the coefficient, {Rear tire cornering coefficient, Cy_r} sets the coefficient, {Vehicle rotational inertia, I} sets the inertia about yaw axis, {Nominal steering ratio, Ksteer} sets the steering ratio and {Tire wheel angle limit, theta} sets the angle limit. Values come from the instance.
